howto.name: Upload 2+ images
howto.text: Drop multiple JPG/PNG/WebP images, up to 500 MB total.

howto.name: Set columns + spacing + background
howto.text: Columns: how wide the collage is. Spacing: gap between images. Background color: visible in the spacing.

howto.name: Download the collage
howto.text: PrivaTools arranges the images in a grid and outputs one JPG file.

faq.a: Each image is scaled to fit its grid cell while preserving aspect ratio. To force same aspect ratio, crop them first with Resize Crop Image.
Drag in the upload area to reorder. They fill left-to-right, top-to-bottom.
Tested up to 100 images. Output JPEG can be up to 30,000 pixels wide before browser limits.
